# Voice-Fidelity QA Rubric

Score each dimension 0–4 if a formal audit is requested; otherwise use as a private checklist.

| Dimension | What excellent performance means |
|---|---|
| Meaning fidelity | Every original idea and relevant qualifier preserved |
| Author reasoning | Central idea, reason, purpose and limitations remain coherent, not formulaic |
| Natural voice | Direct, reflective, concrete, not AI-promotional |
| Evidence fidelity | No invented biography, results, citations or unjustified confidence |
| Technical precision | Scientific terms and model boundaries are correct |
| Language | Grammar clear and sentence lengths purposeful |
| Task fit | Correct audience, format, word limit and editing intensity |

Maximum 28. This is an **editorial review tool**, not a validated authorship metric.

## Critical failures irrespective of score
- Rewriting a frozen thesis title, scope, objective, or definition without authorization.
- Inventing an experience, result, reference or evidence.
- Changing a tentative scientific claim into a confident one.
- Returning a full rewrite when a critique-only response was requested.
- Replacing the author's logic with fashionable but empty phrasing.

## Short acceptance test
Does this read like Dossiya expressing the original idea more clearly, rather than an assistant expressing its own idea? If uncertain, prefer a lighter edit.
